title: Housekeeping Standard on Smoking Cleaning Fees for Guest Folios
content:
Smoking in a non-smoking room leads to a cleaning fee on the Guest Folio at the amount the brand sets, a set maximum number of times per stay, and only where the brand requires a housekeeping report with photographs or a detector log.

| Brand | Smoking cleaning fee | Maximum fees per stay | Housekeeping report with photographs or detector log required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | $250.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | $250.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | $300.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | $350.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | $500.00 | 1 | Yes |
| Ashbury Reserve | $500.00 | 1 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- At every brand the fee is charged at most once per stay, so a stay never carries two smoking cleaning fees.
- At every brand the fee rests on documentation: a housekeeping report with photographs, or a detector log.
- The fee differs by brand from $250.00 at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites up to $500.00 at Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve.

Hypothetical illustration: a documented smoking incident at an Ashbury Grand is charged $350.00 once for the stay, however many nights the stay lasts.
